claims.statement: All configuration is read from environment variables with the RCA_ prefix (or a .env file) via the Settings class in src/rca_agent/config.py, with defaults chosen to run in no-LLM extractive mode without a cluster.
The out-of-the-box defaults reasoning_mode=extractive, cluster_enabled=False, and the resulting demo graph let the agent run with no external dependencies.

Cluster and detection settings include cluster_enabled, kubeconfig_mode (auto/incluster/local), namespace (default open5gs), nf_selector, event_watch_enabled, event_watch_interval_seconds, event_max_age_minutes, status_detection_enabled, status_unhealthy_rebuilds, and incident_correlation_window_minutes.

Optional features fail safe: metrics are skipped when prometheus_url is unset, semantic RAG falls back to the extractive retriever unless its flag, dependencies, and a reachable LLM sidecar all hold, and the service-area feature is inert unless service_area_map_path is set and present.

LLM settings (used only when reasoning_mode is llm) include llm_base_url defaulting to loopback http://127.0.0.1:8090, and any LLM error or unavailable sidecar falls back to the deterministic extractive order so enabling the LLM never changes which causes exist.

Incident capture is off by default (empty incident_capture_path), and its comment warns that capture records include real log lines and object names so the file is sensitive; incident_capture_redact_logs drops log bodies while keeping reasons and timestamps.
